description.narrative: The main objective of the proposed support is to strengthen the pan-African start-up andinnovation ecosystem through a blended catalytic and commercial financing facility calledtimbuktoo Africa Innovation Foundation. Its key purpose would be to nurture the scaling upof impactful innovative technology and technology-enabled (TTE) start-ups across Africa.The proposed financing facility would focus on addressing three issues:1) Gaps in early-stage domestic and international risk capital (venture capital),2) A fragmented and weak start-up ecosystem — specifically with as it relates toentrepreneur support organizations (ESO), government, knowledge and research centres,corporates, industry and even the media; and3) Constraints faced by start-ups in expanding and trading across borders and capturingpan-African market potential

condition.narrative: Social and environmental sustainability will be enhanced through application of the UNDP Social and Environmental Standards (http://www.undp.org/ses) and related Accountability Mechanism (http://www.undp.org/secu-srm).

The Implementing Partner shall ensure that all of its obligations set forth under the section entitled “Legal Context and/or Risk Management Standard Clauses” are passed on to each responsible party, subcontractor and sub-recipient and that all the clauses under this section entitled “Risk Management” are included, mutatis mutandis, in all sub-contracts or sub-agreements entered into further to the Project Document
